title: Undo/Redo System
statement:
Implement an undo/redo system that tracks state changes and allows users to navigate through command history. This is a fundamental pattern for applications like drawing tools, text editors, and design software.

Your implementation should:
1. Maintain a history of states
2. Provide undo() and redo() methods
3. Handle command execution and rollback
4. Manage the history stack efficiently
5. Support clearing history when new changes occur after undo
constraints: Must handle state mutations safely (use immutability)
Must clear redo stack when new command executed after undo
complexity: Time: O(1) for undo/redo, Space: O(n) where n is history size
commonMistakes: Not clearing redo history when executing new command after undo
Mutating state directly instead of creating new state objects
Using push/pop which doesn't handle redo properly - use index-based approach
Forgetting to check canUndo/canRedo before operations
Not properly implementing undo - need to actually reverse the command, not just remove it
Losing reference to canvas context or state when undoing commands
